problems.statement: Let $f:M\to N$ be an $R$-module homomorphism. Prove directly that $\ker f$ is a submodule of $M$ and $\operatorname{im}f$ is a submodule of $N$.

Submodule test

Thus the Hom set has $6\cdot2\cdot6\cdot6=432$ elements.
